QuestInfo.name: Fifth Evan Launch Gift from the Admin
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin has prepared a gift for you to celebrate the launch of Evan. If you're curious about the gift, talk to the Maple Admin.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Admin has prepared 5 different cash items that look especially good on Evan. You can get the fifth item from the Maple Admin when you reach Lv. 21.
QuestInfo.2: You have received all five Evan Launch Gifts from the Admin!

0.0: Hello, Evan! This is the Maple Admin. Congratulations on reaching Lv. 21. Are you ready to receive my last gift?

yes.0: The is the last of the 5 gifts I'm passing out to Evans who are between Lv. 17 and 21. As you know, when you equip all five Evan cash items, you will see a special effect!
yes.1: Please come see me when you're ready to receive my fifth gift.

no.0: It's a special gift that will be given out only until May 4th, so hurry over if you want it!
